Compute Missingness Counts and Percentages

compute_missingness.Rd

Computes the number and percentage of missing values for each variable in a dataset. The function supports both overall missingness (when by = NULL) and grouped missingness (when grouping variables are supplied through the by argument).

Usage

compute_missingness(data, by = NULL)

Arguments

data

A data.frame or data.table containing the dataset to analyze.

by

Optional. A character vector of column names specifying grouping variables. If NULL, missingness is computed for the full dataset.

Value

A data.table in long format with columns:

by

(if provided) Grouping variables.

variable

The variable name.

n_missing

Number of missing values.

pct_missing

Percentage of missingness within group or overall.

Details

When by = NULL, the function returns one row per variable with the total number of missing values and the percent missing out of all rows. When by is provided, missingness is computed within each group, and the percent missing is calculated relative to the group size.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
compute_missingness(df)                # overall missingness
compute_missingness(df, by = "contract_type_code") # missingness by contract type
} # }
